reason: My boys already send photos and updates in the WhatsApp group and it costs me nothing. Paying around 1,600 rupees a month for eight technicians, when I only make about 55,000 a month myself, is hard to justify for something WhatsApp mostly does already.
objection: My technicians won't keep pressing a button and talking after every job. After a week they'll go back to sending a photo in the group, and I'll be paying for an app nobody uses.
would_change_my_mind: If in the free month my technicians really used it on every job, and the AMC reminders brought back renewals I would have missed, worth more than the monthly fee.
